info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Rideshare Rides Routes-v5-spec
info.description: The Rideshare Routes Retrieval API provides an efficient way to access and view detailed information about rideshare routes. This API allows users to retrieve a list of available routes for rideshare services, supporting typical use cases for developers building applications related to transportation and logistics. It is valuable for businesses looking to integrate rideshare data into their platforms, enabling enhanced user experiences and informed decision-making. This API serves both consumer and business applications in the transportation sector.

get.summary: Retrieve the optimal route for rides.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch the most efficient route for their rides. It calculates the route based on various factors such as traffic conditions, distance, and other relevant parameters to enhance the riding experience.
